questions.questionHtml: A cyclist and a runner are 600 meters apart. If they run in the same direction, the cyclist catches the runner in 12 minutes. If they move towards each other, they meet in 3 minutes. What is the speed of the runner, in meters per minute?
questions.solution:
Let
Speed of runner = R
Speed of cyclist = C

Case 1: Same direction
Relative speed = C − R
Time = 12 min
Distance = 600 m

C − R = 600 / 12 = 50

Case 2: Opposite direction
Relative speed = C + R
Time = 3 min
Distance = 600 m

C + R = 600 / 3 = 200

Now add the two equations:

(C − R) + (C + R) = 50 + 200
2C = 250
C = 125

Substitute back:

125 − R = 50
R = 75
